openingMessage: If you leave this meeting knowing one more thing than you walked in with, it worked. Let's make these ten minutes count.
openingWhy: The hand who fought a frozen pump hose trying to kill a well wrote it up on his OWL form — and now every crew that reads it learns that lesson the easy way. One form reaches every trailer in the Basin by morning. What you know only protects people if it moves.
leadershipThought: We win in this business by being invited back the next day. That doesn't just come from doing the job right — it comes from how we carry ourselves as professionals and as people.
